text_to_image_prompt: Create a single-character costume asset for Mara Vale. Mara, an 18-year-old girl with warm light olive-beige skin, scattered freckles across cheeks and nose, hazel-green almond eyes, thick dark softly arched brows, distinct cheekbones, full natural lips, a softly oval-square jaw, and long voluminous ash-brown waves parted in the center. Her hair has fine warm highlights, her face is youthful and she has no glasses. Preserve this exact established character identity, clothing, natural facial proportions and realistic photographic texture. No other characters. Bright soft daylight. Show three outfits of the same character.
